# CityCabs24 - Mumbai Sightseeing & Outstation Cab Service

> Premium private cab and guided sightseeing chauffeur partner based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
> Contact: +91 9833309061 | Email: mumbaicitycabs24@gmail.com | Website: https://citycabs24.com

## Overview
CityCabs24 provides sanitized, air-conditioned chauffeur-driven cabs with experienced local drivers who act as knowledgeable tour guides. Services include local Mumbai city tours, hill station weekend trips, coastal getaways, and spiritual pilgrimage circuits across Maharashtra.

## Key Tour Packages
- [Mumbai Darshan](https://citycabs24.com/mumbai-darshan): 1-day sightseeing covering Gateway of India, Marine Drive, Siddhivinayak, Bandra Bandstand, CSMT, and Haji Ali. Starts from ₹2,499.
- [Lonavala & Khandala Tour](https://citycabs24.com/lonavala-trip): Day and weekend trips to Tiger Point, Bhushi Dam, and Karla Caves. Starts from ₹3,200.
- [Alibaug Sightseeing](https://citycabs24.com/alibaug-sightseeing): Coastal beach and fort tour covering Kolaba Fort, Kashid Beach, and Murud Janjira. Starts from ₹4,000.
- [Matheran Hill Station](https://citycabs24.com/matheran-sightseeing): Chauffeur transfers to Dasturi Naka for eco-sensitive hill station visits. Starts from ₹3,000.
- [Shirdi Sai Baba Tour](https://citycabs24.com/shirdi-tour): Same-day and overnight pilgrimage via Samruddhi Mahamarg expressway. Starts from ₹8,000.
- [Mahabaleshwar & Panchgani](https://citycabs24.com/mahabaleshwar-sightseeing): Multi-day hill station packages covering viewpoints and strawberry farms. Starts from ₹8,500.
- [Igatpuri Waterfall Tour](https://citycabs24.com/igatpuri-tour): Scenic Sahyadri nature tour, Bhavali Dam, and Vipassana Pagoda. Starts from ₹3,500.
- [Ashtavinayak Yatra](https://citycabs24.com/ashtavinayak): 2 to 3 days pilgrimage covering all 8 sacred Ganesha temples.
- [3 Jyotirlinga in Maharashtra](https://citycabs24.com/3-jyotirlinga-in-maharashtra): Trimbakeshwar, Bhimashankar, and Grishneshwar pilgrimage circuit.
- [Konkan Darshan](https://citycabs24.com/konkan-darshan): Coastal Maharashtra road trip covering pristine beaches and sea forts.
- [All Tour Packages](https://citycabs24.com/tours): Complete catalog of private tour packages.
